rows.traditional: 花 A 喺 B 上
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for spending time or effort on a particular matter.

example.english: I devote a lot of time to my studies.
example.traditional: 我成日花時間喺學業上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 faa1 si4 gaan3 hai2 hok6 jip6 soeng6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on directing or concentrating attention, time, or effort on B.

example.english: During meetings, I devote my attention to customers’ needs.
example.traditional: 開會嗰陣，我會將注意力放喺客戶嘅需要。
example.jyutping: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 ngo5 wui5 zoeng1 zyu3 ji3 lik6 fong3 hai2 haak3 wu6 ge3 seoi1 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for giving one's life or self in service, especially in religious, charitable, or public-service contexts.

example.english: They devote their whole life to charitable work.
example.traditional: 佢一生都奉獻畀公益事業。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sang1 dou1 fung6 hin3 bei2 gung1 jik1 si6 jip6
